title: [SOLVED] emby, skia-sharp, skia-sharp2 dependency issues
body: When I run "sudo pacman -Syu" to upgrade my Emby server (running Arch Linux), I get this: $ sudo pacman -Syu ... Total Installed Size: 1305.54 MiB Net Upgrade Size: 14.25 MiB :: Proceed with installation? [Y/n] (69/69) checking keys in keyring [############################################################] 100% (69/69) checking package integrity [############################################################] 100% (69/69) loading package files [############################################################] 100% (69/69) checking for file conflicts [############################################################] 100% error: failed to commit transaction (conflicting files) /usr/lib/libSkiaSharp.so exists in both 'skia-sharp2' and 'skia-sharp' Errors occurred, no packages were upgraded. How do I install updates? Should I try to remove skia-sharp or skia-sharp2 first? Last edited by andyturfer (2026-10-26 13:21:46)
